purpose: Compose canonical Attention memory with the real stable Song-suggestion objects already verified on main so the artist can intentionally and reversibly defer actual N0TE suggestions across every REQ-SCOPE-097 Not Now horizon without a fake task system, duplicate recommendation store, false release inference, provider authority or DAW mutation.

lineage.outcome: The artist can tell N0TE Not Now on a real Song suggestion and N0TE remembers, suppresses it for the chosen horizon, survives relaunch, and lets the artist restore it later.
lineage.capability: Durable reversible Attention deferral over stable real suggestion semantics

why_now: The user explicitly selected real Song suggestions -> durable Not Now over those real objects -> continue SONG-01 -> global reselection. PR #74 supplied and verified the real suggestion objects; PR #75 then reconciled governance to STABLE without changing product behavior. Canonical N0TE_PRODUCT_DB REQ-SCOPE-097 identifies durable Not Now composed with real N0TE suggestions/jobs as the remaining Attention gap.

reuse.new_store_role: Attention deferral ledger only; it never owns suggestion/job content

implementation_contract.canonical_mutation_scope: Attention deferral state and attributable Activity audit events only
implementation_contract.later_this_song: Suppress the semantic suggestion only for the exact Song plus work-Session context that produced it.
implementation_contract.next_song: Suppress while the originating Song remains current; a different Song no longer matches the deferral.
implementation_contract.after_release: Suppress while the originating Song remains current and no exact explicit Song-release evidence is supplied. App/package release state, dates and unrelated releases cannot expire it.
implementation_contract.someday: Artist-scoped durable suppression until explicit restore or supersession.
implementation_contract.never_suggest_again: Artist-scoped durable suppression with an explicit reversible restore path; it is not destructive deletion.
implementation_contract.selection_semantics: CreativeSuggestionService excludes applicable deferred semantic keys before selecting a result; UI hiding alone is insufficient.
implementation_contract.compatibility: When no applicable deferral exists, the deterministic selection introduced by SONG-01-SUGGEST-01 is preserved.
implementation_contract.authority: Not Now changes Attention memory only. It grants no execution eligibility, provider access, spend, publication or DAW mutation authority.

completion_proof: all five canonical REQ-SCOPE-097 horizons are durable and consumer-reachable
deferrals bind to real stable suggestion semantic keys rather than fake placeholder tasks
Later this Song is exact Song plus current work-Session context and stops applying after that context changes
Next Song stops applying when a different Song is current
After release stays fail-closed until exact explicit Song-release evidence for the originating Song is supplied; unrelated release evidence does not expire it
Someday and Never suggest again are Artist-scoped and survive relaunch
every deferral is reversible through a consumer Bring it back path and immutable history remains auditable
applicable deferred suggestions are excluded by CreativeSuggestionService itself
all-available-suggestions-deferred fails closed rather than ignoring Attention state
stale Song/session, foreign Origin, expired CSRF and replayed one-shot actions cannot write a deferral
stable semantic keys remain hidden from normal consumer markup
normal deterministic suggestion selection is unchanged when no applicable deferral exists
no provider/AI call, DAW mutation, action authority or taste-personalization claim is added
full regression and staged consumer smoke pass on Linux, Windows and macOS at the exact implementation head
